text: Si lebbi hormante ɗin ɗi foduɗon ayɓe mon ɓen kisal timmii, haray waree sirkooɓe ɓen kala ka hawruɗon e maɓɓe : huɓindoɗon ɓe e nokkuuji maɓɓe sakkoɗon(tommboɗon) ɓe e ɗate maɓɓe. Si ɓe tuuba- nii Alla e sirku, ɓe niiɓinii julde ɓe yaltinii asakal; haray ɓe wontii musiɗ ɓe mo'on ka diina, accee warugol ɓe. Pellet, Alla ko Haforanoo- wo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
